---
# Shared credential for every OCP-dependent catalog item on this account.
# Rotated externally on 2026-06-23 by the console team; nothing here changed.
__meta__:
  secrets:
    - name: ocp4_token
      from: includes/secrets/ocp4_token.yaml

ocp4_pull_secret_name: ocp4_token
ocp4_registry_host: registry.redhat.io

# ocp4_token itself is ansible-vault encrypted in the include above, so its
# content cannot be inspected from here -- only that every item requires it.
